question: Funso
defaultDirections: Sankhani yankho lomwe mukuona kuti likuyankha funsoli. Mukamaliza, dinani {checkAnswer}. Mudzalandira ndemanga zosonyeza ngati yankho lanu ndi lolondola komanso momwe mungapitirire.
relatedContentDescription: Izi zimapanga malo opindika a zinthu zogwirizana ndi funsoli ndipo zimaonetsedwa nthawi zonse
hintDescription: Izi zimaonetsedwa ngati wogwiritsa ntchito walakwitsa yankho
evidenceDescription: Izi zimaonetsedwa ngati wogwiritsa ntchito wayankha molondola
sortingDirections: Ikani zinthu motsatana moyenera podina mivi ya mmwamba ndi pansi kapena pokoka ndi kuponya. Mukakhulupirira kuti zili motsatana moyenera, yesani yankho lanu posankha {checkAnswer}. Mudzalandira ndemanga pansi pano zosonyeza ngati yankho lanu ndi lolondola.
